author: freel27
quote: This game shouldn’t even be in the running for game of the year from any award show.  This is not Grand Theft Auto.  The story is boring.  The gameplay is tedious, uninteresting, and not what this franchise is about.  Terrible writing and frame rate drops.  The player isn’t free to do as they please due to censorship in certain areas and against certain NPCs.  This game is not fun at all.  Extremely disappointed in what Rockstar has become.

author: freel27
quote: Generic gameplay, repetitive boring combat, ugly character designs, dull boss fights, and bland environments. Some sections practically play themselves, making your input feel irrelevant.

author: freel27
quote: After playing 10 hours of a free trial there is no reason to play this over Madden 23 if you're a franchise player.  I felt no player impact on any defensive hit stick.  It seems that all tackling and hits are soft compared to last years game.  Also, I don't want to sit there, after the game, for 30 seconds looking at highlight screenshots.  I want to finish the game and move on to the next.  The game also crashed 5 times in 10 hours.

author: freel27
quote: I’m glad Square Enix made this an action RPG.  Turn-based hasn’t ever appealed to me.  This is my first Final Fantasy game and I really like it so far.  I can’t think of any negatives.  An overall enjoyable experience.

author: freel27
quote: Just an absolute dumpster fire.  Arkane and Microsoft should be ashamed of themselves.

author: freel27
quote: Even after the first patch since it's release the performance is upsetting.  This game does not deserve anywhere near a score of 10.  These developers need to get it together and ship out games that are finished.  If they expect us to pay full price for a game the game better be fully finished.

author: freel27
quote: Loved the music and graphics in this game.  Although the game is easy I enjoyed the quests.

author: freel27
quote: This game is a masterpiece!  Can’t stop playing it.  Runs great on the PS5.
